item.title: AG Ellison, Rep. Norris, Sen. Johnson Stewart introduce bipartisan bill cracking down on Medicaid fraud
item.description:
Publication Date: February 25, 2026

Bill expands the size of Medicaid Fraud Control Unit (MFCU) to account for tripling of fraud referrals the unit receives, strengthens state Medical Assistance fraud law, and expands MFCU’s investigative power

https://www.ag.state.mn.us/Office/Communications/2026/02/25_MedicaidFraud.asp
